sourceSentences: Seraphine's basic ability casts each generate a stack of Echo, stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, the next basic ability cast consumes them all to cast an additional time at no cost after a delay. Seraphine gains maximum stacks of Echo when the game starts and upon respawning.
Seraphine's ability casts grant a Note to herself and nearby allied champions that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent Notes and stacks up to 4 times on each unit.
While any amount of Notes are active, Seraphine's next basic attack is empowered to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus attack range per Note, and fire all Notes at the target
If Seraphine already had a shield at the time of cast, Surround Sound will pulse after the duration, healing herself and nearby allied champions.
Enemies that are already slowed are also rooted for the same duration.
Enemies that are immobilized or grounded are also stunned for the same duration.
Beat Drop will only be empowered from slows, immobilizes, and grounding effects applied by herself or her allies.
Seraphine projects a captivating force in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit, charms them, during which they are revealed, and slows them by 40% for a duration
Encore's projectile resets its remaining travel distance whenever it hits an allied or enemy champion, excluding Seraphine.
Encore will not extend on enemy champions that are untargetable, but will do so for allied champions.
If Encore's projectile is negated via spell shield, this will also prevent it from resetting its travel distance.
Encore has two cast times. Both last 0.5 seconds. The wave will always project after the first cast time, and the second cast time only serves as a lockout for Seraphine.
Seraphine cannot buffer casts during the first cast time, but she may do so during the second cast time.
Avec deux cumuls, sa compétence suivante est lancée deux fois. Son deuxième passif lui octroie, ainsi qu'aux alliés proches, une note à chaque sort lancé.
Si elle possède déjà un bouclier, elle soigne aussi ses alliés après un court délai. Si elle utilise son passif pour lancer ce sort deux fois, elle applique boucliers et soins.

Chaque fois qu'il traverse un champion, allié ou ennemi, la distance de trajet est réinitialisée. En combo, engagez avec l'ultime, puis E, A et Z avant de vous replier. Si vous réussissez un double E, enchaînez avec l'ultime, le A et le
une grande partie de votre talent réside dans le choix de la compétence que vous doublez.
Si votre ADC dispose d'un ralentissement, attendez toujours qu'il le place avant de lancer votre E.
